facts.text: Product: Cocoon Cool Grey Fabric 3 Seater Sofa.
The listed variant options include Cool Grey and 3 Seater; the specifications identify this product as Cool Grey with seating capacity 3 Seater.
The product is fabric upholstered, as stated in its title.
The seat has channel tufting and the sofa has extra-deep seating.
The product dimensions are 226 cm long × 101 cm wide × 92.5 cm high.
The product listing describes its fabric as soil-, stain-, oil- and water-repellant.
